algorithm_descriptions.bptt: Backpropagation Through Time with Adam optimizer (gold standard)
algorithm_descriptions.opca: Oscillatory Phase Credit Assignment: credit propagated using W (no transpose) with Adam
algorithm_descriptions.fa: Feedback Alignment: credit propagated using fixed random matrix B with Adam
algorithm_descriptions.rflo: RFLO-like: random feedback with changing random matrices at each iteration
algorithm_descriptions.opca_alpha: OPCA with learned damping factor alpha (initialized at 0.9)
